Guidance & outlook: (b) Indian Economy India continued to remain the fastest-growing major economy in the world during FY 2025-26. - GDP Growth: Real GDP growth for FY 2025-26 is estimated at 6.3% to 6.8%.

Services remained robust at 7.2%, driven by financial services, real estate, professional services, and public administration. - Fiscal & Inflation: The fiscal deficit is projected to improve to 4.4% of GDP in FY 2025-26 from 4.8% in FY 2024-25.

CPI inflation softened and is projected to align closer to RBI's target of ∼4% in FY 2026, supported by favorable monsoon and lower food inflation. - Outlook: India's nominal GDP has expanded significantly over the last decade.
Growth & demand: As per OECD projections, global GDP growth moderated to 2.9% in 2025 and is expected to remain at 2.9% in 2026.
Growth in 2025 remained subdued, with global output rising by an estimated 2.6% and US growth at around 1.1%.
Real GVA growth is estimated at 6.4%. - Sectoral Performance: Agriculture rebounded with an estimated growth of 3.8%.
Margins & costs: Threats - Global volatility impacting funding costs and capital market sentiment. - Regulatory changes and increased compliance requirements under SBR. - Interest rate fluctuations, liquidity pressures, and competition from banks and FinTechs. - Geopolitical risks affecting crude prices and imported inflation.
